textureVariants: GLBs reference the 1k KTX2 files by relative uri. Quality tiers that want 2k rewrite "_1k.ktx2" to "_2k.ktx2" in a LoadingManager URL modifier; every texture has both files.
customAttributes: three.js GLTFLoader lower-cases custom attributes: _FIN_MASK is geometry attribute "_fin_mask" (0 rigid body, 1 fin tip) and _FIN_ID is "_fin_id" (0 body, 1 caudal, 2 dorsal, 3 anal, 4 pectoral, 5 pelvic). Anemone tentacle sway is "_sway" (0 base, 1 tip). Shrimp reuse _fin_id (0 body and eyes, 6 leg, 7 antenna, 8 pleopod, 9 abdomen and tail fan) and _fin_mask (weight along the limb, 0 root to 1 tip) and add "_leg" (limb index: pair * 2 + side, side 0 = -x).
